description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericAsyncEngine' that extends 'AbstractEngine'. It provides methods for executing services synchronously and asynchronously within the OFBiz framework, including support for persisting asynchronous jobs through interaction with job and delegator components. The class appears to implement core mechanisms for managing execution modes and job scheduling but does not include concrete implementations of abstract methods.

classes.name: GenericAsyncEngine
classes.description: An abstract engine class for managing asynchronous service execution within the OFBiz framework, supporting both persistent and in-memory job scheduling, and defining core methods for synchronous and asynchronous operation modes.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Abstract method for executing a service synchronously, returning a result map.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Abstract method for executing a service synchronously, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Overloaded method to execute a service asynchronously with or without a requester, optionally persisting the job.

methods.name: allowCallbacks
methods.description: Checks whether callbacks are allowed for a given service and context based on the execution mode.
